# Gotthard Traffic Live

> Live waiting times, queue length, and road status for the Gotthard road tunnel (A2, Switzerland) and the Gotthard Pass mountain road, refreshed automatically from official Swiss traffic data.

This is an independent, unofficial project. It is not affiliated with ASTRA (the Swiss Federal Roads Office) or any official authority. For safety-critical travel decisions, use official channels.

## Pages
- Dashboard, German (default): /
- Dashboard, English: /?lang=en

## Machine-readable data
- Current status (JSON, refreshed every ~10-15 min): /data/gotthard.json
- Queue length / wait time history, last 48h (JSON): /data/history.json

The current-status JSON has this shape:

```
{
  "updated": "<ISO 8601 timestamp>",
  "source": "opentransportdata.swiss (ASTRA Traffic Situations)",
  "tunnel": {
    "status": "open | congested | restricted | closed | unknown",
    "north": { "queueKm": <number|null>, "waitMinutes": <number|null>, "cause": "<string|null>" },
    "south": { "queueKm": <number|null>, "waitMinutes": <number|null>, "cause": "<string|null>" }
  },
  "pass": { "status": "open | closed | restricted | unknown", "note": "<string|null>" }
}
```

"north" refers to the Göschenen portal (Uri/German-speaking side), "south" to the Airolo portal (Ticino/Italian-speaking side). "queueKm" is the reported traffic queue length in kilometers; "waitMinutes" is the estimated additional waiting time.

## Data source
Traffic situations are sourced from the ASTRA / opentransportdata.swiss "Traffic Situations" open data feed: https://opentransportdata.swiss/en/road-traffic/
